cases.name: ingress-from-controller
cases.purpose: A peer carrying the ingress controller's labels reaches the data listener.

cases.name: ingress-from-same-namespace
cases.purpose: An unlabelled pod beside the gateway is refused at the data listener.

cases.name: ingress-from-other-namespace
cases.purpose: Controller labels outside the ingress namespace are not enough.

cases.name: dns-from-gateway
cases.purpose: Gateway pods resolve names through cluster DNS.

cases.name: egress-to-upstream
cases.purpose: Gateway pods reach a labelled upstream on 443. Replace with the real upstream, IdP and database destinations.

cases.name: api-from-unrestricted-pod
cases.purpose: The Kubernetes API is reachable from a pod no egress policy restricts.

cases.name: egress-to-api-server
cases.purpose: Gateway pods cannot open connections to the Kubernetes API.

cases.name: egress-to-metadata
cases.unattributed_reason: Not every platform serves instance metadata to pods. Where it does, add an allow case from an unrestricted pod and name it as the control.
cases.purpose: Gateway pods cannot reach the cloud instance metadata endpoint.
